source.title: Materials of Significance
source.description: Each of the Echoing Orbs is attuned to a different aspect of its master and the method you used in Ashenvale to destroy the Althalaxx Orb will not be effective on the orb we possess. I know of a ritual that may be able to destabilize the orb and allow us to destroy it, but it requires components with specific magical significance. We already possess some of the required materials, but you'll need to retrieve the rest. Take this, it should help you in your search.
source.objective:
Locate the materials listed in Gregory's Note and return them to Gregory at the source of Bloodvenom Falls in Felwood.

Provided item:
source.progress: It must have been quite the adventure to obtain these items. Well done.
source.completion: Now that we have the materials, I must prepare the ritual. For now, consult with Aeonas. He wishes to speak with you.
